bag_prompt:
Use case: compositing / product-mockup.
Image 1 is the PRIMARY artwork reference: two Utkal cup designs, terracotta riverbank scene on left, sea-blue maritime sailing scene on right. Image 2 is the bag CONSTRUCTION and Tasar silk texture reference only.
Create a photoreal studio image of TWO TASAR SILK JHULA BAGS side by side carrying the SAME designs as the two cups. No cups in the output.
LEFT BAG: dyed Mankada Pathara terracotta Tasar silk outer, broad matching silk-covered reinforced shoulder handles, cotton lining subtle at opening. Transfer the left cup's design faithfully onto its flat front: large ivory uppercase serif UTKAL at the top, the same riverbank women launching lamp boats, palms, low sun, sailing boat and flowing waves below. Preserve the source scene's distinctive layout, imagery and restrained ivory/straw colours. Do not replace it with the book-and-boat logo.
RIGHT BAG: dyed deep Nila Sagara sea blue Tasar silk outer with the same construction. Transfer the right cup's design faithfully: large ivory uppercase serif UTKAL above a laterite-sailed boat, straw sun, ivory waves, birds and distant palm-lined shore. Recompose only enough to fit a vertical bag panel; retain recognisable same scene.
Both bags softly structured and gusseted, believable fine slub silk weave and restrained sheen, no burlap/jute texture, full bags and long handles visible, no handles obscuring artwork, warm ivory tabletop/background, premium natural studio light. Same scale and angle for both. No extra words, slogans, certification marks, borders unrelated to reference or watermark. Only UTKAL text. Concept imagery, not manufactured samples.
tshirt_prompt:
Use case: compositing / product-mockup.
Image 1: EXISTING BLACK UTKAL T-SHIRT FRONT, preserve its print and shirt style. Image 2: CUP STORY ARTWORK to transfer to the back, especially the RIGHT sea-blue cup's sailing scene.
Create a premium studio product photograph showing TWO VIEWS of the SAME BLACK T-shirt side by side, FRONT on left and BACK on right, on simple wooden hangers against a warm ivory backdrop. Entire shirts in frame and same scale, no people. Only two shirts.
LEFT FRONT: preserve the existing ivory book/two-sail emblem, laterite hull, two straw wave lines and ivory Odia Utkal wordmark from reference 1. Preserve the original placement/scale; do not add a front story panel or new English words.
RIGHT BACK: put a LARGE ivory uppercase serif "UTKAL" at the upper back, with the matching CUP'S MARITIME GRAPHICAL STORY beneath: graceful traditional sailing boat with laterite sails, straw sun, ivory waves and birds, small palm-lined distant shore. Faithfully adapt the right cup's composition, silhouettes and palette to a broad vertical back-print area. The black shirt itself is the background: no blue rectangular panel, no transfer-sticker box, no huge solid ink slab. Illustrated shapes flow into open black space. Print centred with sensible collar, hem and side margins.
This is the same graphical design family across cup, Tasar bag and T-shirt back. No story paragraphs, labels reading front/back, slogans, new emblems, extra text, watermarks or certification badges. Realistic matte black cotton and natural drape; soft studio daylight. Production design concept, not a manufactured sample photograph.
